about: AIContextJourneyTests: empty planner with a text-only stored chat. Assistant aside deliberately mentions another activity and time; follow-ups must recover the user's dinner alarm context. Dates use the current local day.

chats.title: Dinner alarm context
messages: At 6pm tonight, remind me not to eat dinner again.
We can talk about watering plants at 9am too.
